requirements.name: A transporter is chosen from one combined list, not asked for by type first

scenarios.name: The transporter list offers commercial and private transporters together

tests.test: does not ask the transporter type before the list
lists every transporter the service knows about in headed columns, each row showing its address, approval number and type
tests.notes: both commercial and private records rendered in the one table

tests.test: lists both a commercial and a private transporter

requirements.name: Adding a transporter not on the list asks its type first, to decide which form to show

scenarios.name: Adding a commercial transporter asks its type, then the commercial form

tests.test: commercial branch routes to the add-commercial form
commercial transporter is owed only for the commercial type and is wiped when the type changes

scenarios.name: Adding a private transporter asks its type, then the private form

tests.test: private branch routes to its details page and persists on back
the saved country shows on the review's Transport details card, and a saved private transporter survives an add of the other type that the trader cancels

scenarios.name: Completing an add returns to the transporter list, and the record joins the list as the notification's pick

tests.test: a transporter the trader added is on the list, checked, and saving the list again leaves it alone
tests.notes: commercial add; asserts the added radio is checked on the list, saves the list and lands on Overview, then confirms the add form still holds the record; red then green with the save landing on Upload documents (workareas/shared/eudpa-774/logs/inc-030-probe-commercial-add-lands-on-list-fit)

tests.test: a transporter the trader added is on the list, checked, and saving the list again leaves it alone
tests.notes: private add, same assertions; red then green with the save landing on Upload documents (workareas/shared/eudpa-774/logs/inc-030-probe-private-add-lands-on-list-fit)

tests.test: commercial transporter is owed only for the commercial type and is wiped when the type changes
tests.notes: reaches Overview through the list save after the add; does not assert the list shown straight after the add

scenarios.name: A transporter added on one notification is offered on the next

tests.test: a transporter added on one notification is on the list of the next one, ready to pick
tests.notes: private add; second notification's row shows address, type Private and status New; picking it refills the private form

scenarios.name: The type question returns to the list rather than forward

tests.test: the type question goes back to the list

requirements.name: Changing the add-detour's type discards the record the previous type held

scenarios.name: Returning to Commercial after adding as Private shows an empty commercial form

tests.test: commercial transporter is owed only for the commercial type and is wiped when the type changes
tests.notes: adds Commercial, switches to Private, switches back to Commercial and asserts the form is empty

scenarios.name: Returning to Private after adding as Commercial shows the private form blank, Country select back on the United Kingdom

tests.test: adding a private transporter after saving private and commercial ones opens a blank form with country on the United Kingdom
tests.notes: red then green with the private record kept in scope under the Commercial type (workareas/shared/eudpa-774/logs/inc-030-probe-private-wiped-on-type-change-fit)

scenarios.name: Cancelling an add of the other type keeps the record the earlier type held

tests.test: the saved country shows on the review's Transport details card, and a saved private transporter survives an add of the other type that the trader cancels
tests.notes: adds Private, switches to Commercial, cancels that form, then returns to Private and asserts the details it entered are still there
